content: git worktree per feature: use 'git worktree add' with a dedicated branch, 'git worktree remove' to delete (never rm -rf, which leaves stale admin entries requiring 'git worktree prune'). 'git worktree list --porcelain' or -z for machine-parseable output. Locked worktrees are never pruned. Real-world AI-agent usage accumulates hundreds of worktrees and stale branches consuming tens of GB, so lifecycle/GC is mandatory. Worktrees share one object store, so concurrent gc/fetch across worktrees needs care, and a branch cannot be checked out in two worktrees at once.
